name: Word Count
description: 统计工作区文本文件里的单词数。Counts words in a workspace text file.

tools.name: word_count
tools.description: Count whitespace-separated words in a UTF-8 text file inside the workspace. Output is the integer count and nothing else. Does not follow paths outside the workspace and does not modify the file.

path.description: Workspace-relative path to a text file.
